rules.statement: A notary who has been authorized to dispense with the search for prior registration and does not make a note of any such prior registration on the deed, commits no offense if the deed is tendered for registration by another notary.
rules.supporting_quote: Where parties to a transaction affecting land authorized the notary in writing to dispense with the search for prior registrations, and the notary drew up the deed and did not note on the deed prior registration, and the deed was not tendered for registration by him,- Held , that the notary had not committed an offence under section 29 (16) of Ordinance No. 1 of 1907.
